page.overview:
What is Radioactive Man?

"Radioactive Man" is the second episode of Season 7, being the 130th episode overall. It originally aired on September 24, 1995. The episode was written by John Swartzwelder and directed by Susie Dietter. It features guest stars Mickey Rooney as himself and Phil Hartman as Lionel Hutz, and is the first Simpsons episode to be animated with digital ink and paint rather than traditional cell animation (though it would take years for digital ink and paint to replace traditional cel animation, not just on The Simpsons, but on all animated works in America).

A movie based on comic book character Radioactive Man is filmed in Springfield. Much to Bart's chagrin, the coveted part of the hero's sidekick, Fallout Boy, goes to not him, but to his best friend Milhouse.
